claim: Road 2 Web Summit is in its eleventh edition.
Road 2 Web Summit selects up to 125 Portuguese startups for this year's summit.
Web Summit runs in Lisbon from 9 to 12 November.
Galp sponsors a 15,000-euro prize for the Most Promising Startup.
Galp sponsors a 5,000-euro prize for the Best Performing Startup.
The 2026 winner is announced at a press conference on Thursday 12 November at 12:30 on Stage 2.
Selected startups get 50% off Web Summit's ALPHA or BETA startup packages.
Since 2016, the programme has supported more than 1,200 Portuguese startups.
In 2025 the programme supported 115 startups, which together raised 40 million euros.
Framedrop.ai, from Coimbra, and Deeploy won the prizes in 2024.
